raw_snippet: Nscale, a full-stack AI cloud platform, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Anyscale, the platform for scaling any AI workload - data processing, training, inference and reinforcement learning - across thousands of GPUs.
note: Nscale -> Anyscale (Ray-based compute platform for AI training, reinforcement learning and inference); sublayer inference_serving, its entity's primary membership; acquisition; closing is tied to Nscale's IPO. Ledger sweep of 23 Sep 2026.
